answer.summary: E2E app container crashed at startup: Flyway found two migrations with the same version V6_20261118120000000 (one from this PR's Catalog_connector_injector_contracts migration, the other Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side). The duplicate version is deterministic and will fail again on re-run, so fix the version collision.

evidence.quote: Caused by: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Duplicate Flyway migration version found: V6_20261118120000000__Request_finding_refeed_for_asset_groups_side.class
